name: Datum Sim
tagline: Model and simulate dynamic systems: block diagrams, control and motors.
for: Control, mechanical, electrical, process and mechatronics engineers, researchers and students.
highlights: Draw a model as blocks and wires, press Run and watch live scopes
About 45 blocks: sources, math, transfer functions, state space, PID, delays, discontinuities, lookup tables
DC motor and permanent-magnet synchronous motor blocks, with worked speed and position control examples
Subsystems: group blocks into one, open them, nest them
Five solvers, from fixed-step Euler to variable-step and stiff, with exact switching times
Parameter sweeps, step-response specifications, and Bode plots from the built-in Python engine
Every solver and block checked against known answers

roadmap.title: First releases
items: Signed releases through the in-app updater
More worked examples and a printable verification report
Wire branch points and labels on wires
Faster drawing of very large diagrams

roadmap.title: Bigger models
items: Masks: a subsystem with its own parameter dialog
Discrete and multi-rate blocks: discrete transfer functions and PID
Integrator reset and more event blocks

roadmap.title: Control design
items: Operating points (trim) and linearisation of whole models

roadmap.title: Physical components
items: Mechanical, rotational, electrical, hydraulic and thermal components you connect by ports
The app writes and solves the equations (DAEs)

roadmap.title: Exchange
items: Modelica models through an external compiler

roadmap.title: Studies
items: Fitting model parameters to measured data
